It all matches, including both documented examples (empty lines → zero totals; the 19999-cent line → credit 1999, due 18000).

- `python3 test_public.py --cases public_tests/release_1_statement.json` — passes (the supplied one-line receipt case)
- All five public suites — 7 cases, all pass
- All local tests — 40 tests, all pass, including release 1.0 statement priority/input-order, empty statement, and statement-totals-equal-total cases
- Omitted release still selects 2.0; quote, total, ping, and unknown-command behavior unchanged
